faq.zombieEscapeA: Zombie Escape (ZE) is a cooperative Counter-Strike game mode in which a team of humans runs a scripted map route while infected players chase them. Humans win by reaching the escape point before the round timer expires, and every human caught joins the zombie team. Maps are purpose-built for the mode, often running fifteen minutes or longer and ending in a boss fight. ZE has been played continuously since Counter-Strike: Source, and active communities today run servers on Counter-Strike 2 (CS2), Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO) and Counter-Strike: Source (CS:S).
faq.zeGraphA: ZE Graph records live player counts and map rotations from every server it tracks, then turns that history into playtime rankings, per-map analytics and geographic player distribution. You can see which maps hold players longest, how a server's population moves through the day, where its players connect from, and how one player's playtime compares across the communities they play on. Data updates continuously, and per-map and per-player pages reach back as far as each server has been tracked.
faq.supportedQ: What servers and communities are supported in ZE Graph?
faq.supportedA: ZE Graph currently tracks {communities} and {servers} across {games}: {list}. Every server listed on the home page is polled continuously, so its population and map rotation appear here in real time. If your community's Zombie Escape server is not listed yet, use the "Request a Server" button on the home page to submit it.
faq.supportedFallbackA: ZE Graph tracks Zombie Escape servers from communities such as GFL, Mapeadores, RSS, PSE, Net4All and Cola-Team, across Counter-Strike 2, Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike: Source. The live list of every supported community and server is shown on the home page. If your community's Zombie Escape server is not listed yet, use the "Request a Server" button on the home page to submit it.
faq.trackedQ: How to be tracked by ZE Graph?
faq.trackedA: Just play. ZE Graph reads the live player list of every server it tracks, so connecting to any supported Counter Strike Zombie Escape server is enough for your session to be recorded against your Steam account or by name. There is no sign-up, no plugin to install and nothing to configure, and your playtime starts accumulating from the first session seen. Signing in with Steam is optional, you're able to adjust your privacy settings, where you can also anonymize your profile so it is hidden from other visitors. If the server you play on is not tracked yet, request it from the home page and your history there will begin once it is added.
faq.trackedOwnerIntro: If you're a server owner asking to be tracked, you need to share API endpoints for:
faq.trackedOwnerConnectionIds: User Connection IDs: live Steam IDs of the players in the server at the current time
faq.trackedOwnerMapCooldowns: Map Cooldowns: the current map rotation and cooldown state of each map
faq.trackedOwnerInfractions: User Infractions: data on player bans, mutes, item blocks and similar (optional)
faq.trackedOwnerContact: If you want to integrate your server's data or have your server added to {domain}, please reach out to @flowerpad on Discord or <link>join the Discord server</link>.
faq.statisticsA: For each player, ZE Graph calculates total playtime split into casual and tryhard time, global and per-map rankings, per-map playtime, the communities and servers played on, session history and any infraction records. For each map it calculates the dropoff rate, average session length and the distribution of session durations, plus the regions its players connect from and the players who have spent the most time on it. For each server it tracks population over time, unique player counts, map rotation history and the geographic distribution of its players by country and continent.
